newsitem.title: USA: Millennium installation starts rev stream.
newsitem.headline: Millennium installation starts rev stream.

text.p: Millennium Pharmaceuticals on Wednesday said that it has completed the installation of its software platform at American Home Products Corp's Wyeth-Ayerst Research, kicking off a long-term revenue stream for access to this technology.
This completes the first of three phases of a research bioinformatics technology transfer agreement struck between the firms in July 1996, worth $90 million over seven years.

Millennium chief financial officer Harry Arader told reuters that this phase represents a "significant" portion of the $90 million, but declined to note specific financial details. He noted that the initial revenue will be recorded as part of the firm's first quarter results.

Last July, Millennium said that in addition to the access fees, it would also receive payments based on the attainment of certain research milestones and royalties based on sales of Wyeth-Ayerst products arising from the collaboration.
Millennium's Sequence Explorer gene technology software platform coordinates DNA sequencing sample management, provides researchers access to public databases, as well as controling data warehousing.
